name: Founder Launch
tagline: A founder talking to camera and screen recordings go in, a tight launch video for X comes out.
description: The launch video founders post when they ship: a cold open that makes people stay, why you built it, the product working on screen, proof or the offer, and one link. Your best takes are kept, the pauses and retakes go, and big words, captions and brand cards are added on top. It sounds like you on a good day.
bring: A recording of you talking to camera (a phone is fine)
Your logo and link. Optional: an outline, numbers, customer quotes, music
get: A 45–90 s launch video with captions, callouts and music (16:9, or 9:16 on request)

needs.name: Pause cutter and launch music scripts
Hyperframes (or your video tool or editor), Python 3 and ffmpeg

steps: Pick the best lines and agree on the story
Cut a rough version and check it
Add the product on screen, big words, captions and brand cards
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
